description: Read-only XRPL canonical ledger-object lookup for one account. Use this low-level catch-all when raw ledger-entry objects are required or when no dedicated N9T2 view exists. Use n9t2_xrpl_list_account_nfts for NFTs owned by the account, n9t2_xrpl_list_nft_offers for marketplace buy/sell offers on a specific NFTokenID, n9t2_xrpl_list_account_offers for classic DEX offers, and n9t2_xrpl_list_account_channels for Payment Channels. Set object_type to `nft_offer` only when raw NFTokenOffer ledger entries are required; use `ledger_index` to pin the lookup and `limit`/`marker` for pagination.

account.description: XRPL classic account address whose canonical ledger objects should be inspected.
account.title: Account

deletion_blockers_only.description: Whether to return only ledger objects that prevent account deletion.
deletion_blockers_only.title: Deletion Blockers Only

ledger_index.description: Optional validated ledger index or selector.
ledger_index.title: Ledger Index

limit.description: Optional maximum number of ledger objects to return.
limit.title: Limit

marker.description: Pagination marker returned by a previous response.
marker.title: Marker

object_type.description: Optional XRPL ledger-entry type filter. Use 'nft_offer' for account-level NFTokenOffer ledger entries.
object_type.title: Object Type

sponsored.description: Optional filter controlling sponsored ledger objects.
sponsored.title: Sponsored

name: n9t2_xrpl_list_account_objects
